question: In October 2022, ‘Tele-MANAS’ initiative was launched by the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. What does ‘M’ stand for in MANAS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mental health.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tele MANAS**

 
 
• **The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** started the "**Tele-MANAS**" project in October 2022. **M stands for mental health in MANAS.**
 
• In October 2022, the **Tele-MANAS (Telemental Health Assistance and Networking Across States)** initiative was launched by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare.
 
• In order to provide free, round-the-clock tele-mental health services to everyone in the country,** Tele-MANAS **is concentrating on underprivileged or isolated communities.
 
• The plan includes a network of 23 centres for tele-mental health excellence, with NIMHANS acting as the scheme's nodal body and the **International Institute of** **Information Technology-Bangalore (IIITB)** offering technical support.
 
• **The National Health Systems Resource Center (NHRSC) **and the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT)** Bangalore would provide technical support.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mental health**

 
 
• Our mental health includes all aspects of our** emotional, psychological, and social well-being**. It has an impact on our attitudes, feelings, and actions. It also affects how we deal with stress, communicate with others, and make wise decisions.
 
• From childhood and youth to adulthood, every stage of life is important for maintaining mental health.
 
• Despite the fact that the terms are commonly used interchangeably, poor mental health and mental illness are not the same. A person can have poor mental health even if they do not have a mental condition.
 
• A person who suffers from a mental illness may also experience periods of excellent physical, mental, and** social health.**
